BiblicalUsage: The word is a work, a deed done, and all three of its uses belong to the works of God. Wisdom says the LORD possessed her before His works of old, and the psalms call the people to come and behold the works of the LORD and to see how awesome He is in His doing toward the children of men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the works are the evidence. God is known by what He has done, and the call is not to argue about Him but to come and look.
